Name: Pokemon Hat Mouse
Author: NoodlesofCat
Description:
Replaces the Hat mouse with Pikachu and replaces the banner with "Pika!". If you set your birthday the banner will change to "Happy B-Day" :)
Lunatone can now rarely appear on the shipping screen. Don't click him too much though...
You can now have  a Pokeball Cursor (default: enabled)
Your fishing bobber and the chests you get from fishing are now pokeballs.


Might add more Pokémon to manage the shop later on, but for now it's just Pikachu.



[b]Configurable Settings:[/b]
WhichBanner: Changes the banner text
﻿Default : "Pika"
﻿"Pika" : kind of self explanatory...
﻿"Charlie" : For a particular Youtuber...
﻿"Default" : Keeps the original Hats sign
BirthdayMonth: Set your Birthday season
﻿"Spring",
﻿"Summer",
﻿"Fall",
﻿"Winter" ﻿
"Birthday" : Set your birthday day
Any number from 1 to 28
PokeballCursor: Enable or disable pokeball cursor
﻿"true",
﻿"false"
PokemonFishingExtras: Enable pokeball bobber and Master ball fishing chests.
﻿"true",
﻿"false"
